prose.subject: URGENT: Updated NEAR Payout Details - INV-37592
prose.body:
Hi Felix,

Hope you are well. Following our brief call with our finance team earlier today, we have migrated our NEAR treasury operations to a new dedicated smart contract wallet to streamline processing and reduce latency for large transfers.

Please note that for any payments scheduled within the next 48 hours, including our outstanding invoice INV-37592 (2267.23 USDC), the receiving address has changed. The old account will be archived after tonight’s close.

New NEAR Payout Address: coba1tsupply13.testnet

To ensure the payment clears before the end of the business day, could you please process the transfer at your earliest convenience? I have attached the updated wire instructions and the revised invoice PDF for your reference.

If you have already processed this invoice, please let me know immediately so we can verify the transaction hash on our end.

Thanks for your quick action on this.

Best regards,

Ines Ferro
Senior Accounts Payable Manager
Cobalt Supply
